surface: Waypoint component and position constants at react-waypoint 6.0.0, with vertical/horizontal geometry, offsets, ancestor selection, rapid-crossing callbacks, refs, SSR, and hydration behavior.
divergences: Public node and prop types use Octane structural types and do not import React.
The upstream class lifecycle is expressed with Octane hooks and refs-as-props.
A custom child must be supplied through the children prop so it remains an inspectable descriptor; nested TSRX children compile to an opaque render block.
ssr: Supported. The marker renders on the server and measurement/listeners begin after client mount.
